description: Flügel and collaborators publish a synthetic metropolitan Oslo population for transport modelling. The public Zenodo file is a compressed MATSim XML sample of one percent of the stated 1.3 million synthetic people, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Its description identifies person coordinates, timed daily activities, activity types and transport modes, assembled by fusing official register data. The sample can seed or test agent-based travel-demand and infrastructure-accessibility simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Oslo population. A limitation is that the public file is a sample, not the full 1.3 million-agent population; the provider says other formats and parameters are on request. The page does not state sampling weights, network compatibility or privacy checks, so a modeller cannot infer full-city trip totals directly from the sample. The licence restricts commercial reuse and requires share-alike for adaptations. The XML payload was not downloaded or parsed, and its coordinate reference system was not checked.
